summary: ADC Therapeutics SA filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing a definitive agreement dated October 7, 2026, for a $86.6 million private placement with institutional investors. The company will issue 12,911,347 common shares at $1.4200 and pre-funded warrants for 48,088,653 shares at $1.32400, reflecting a $0.096 exercise price. Closing is expected October 22, 2026, subject to customary conditions, with a 30-business-day resale registration deadline. This is a routine exempt financing under Section 4(a)(2), not a special situation; watch for registration timing and warrant overhang.
